messages:
maria: Proposal: add a "route inspector" compact row in Console that surfaces routing policy, active quotas, and a "preview rollout" UX to view per-model metrics for split routes. Aim is fast incident triage and fewer surprises.

sam: +1. preview rollout sounds great. how would we fetch per-model metrics? we currently only index by route.

joel: we'd need a model dimension on telemetry or a query-time join to the routing ledger. downside: storage growth. idea: maintain a short-lived model-index for routes with active splits (TTL 7d).

liz: ux: the inspector should show a small heatmap per-model (p50, p95, err) and a toggle to "inline sample" using the route's sample rate. otherwise the numbers look off.

maria: agree. also thinking about saved queries: they should carry a schema_version so Console can surface a compatibility warning if telemetry dims changed since the view was saved.

ana: ana: +1 on schema_version. real example: saved view expects metric 'latency_ms' but after instrumentation we rename to 'latency_p50_ms' and view silently breaks. versioning avoids that.

sam: implementation detail: PATCH /api/saved_views/{id} -> accept { "preserve_model_pin": true|false, "schema_version": "v1" }. and GET /api/saved_views/{id}/compat returns compatibility hints.

joel: from infra side, we should also tag telemetry with a provenance hash when schema changes. compatibility check is then a hash compare. cheap and deterministic.

liz: badge idea: route row shows a small quota pill: green if under, amber near cap, red if throttled. clicking pill opens a modal with current quota window, consumed, and fallback route.

maria: nice. one more edge: when a saved view has an explicit model_pin and that model is rolled out away (no longer routable), Console should show an overlay: "model not active on this route" and a one-click apply-latest fallback.

sam: must audit that action. if someone changes model pin via Console we should emit an event. deploy-bot: can you add `saved_view.apply_model_pin` and `route.model.override` events? include user, saved_view_id, route_id, old_model, new_model, reason.

deploy-bot: created INF-4501. will emit events: `saved_view.apply_model_pin`, `route.model.override`. payload includes user, saved_view_id, route_id, old_model, new_model, timestamp, reason (optional). :white_check_mark:

joel: telemetry cost mitigation: only enable model-dim indexing when route has >X traffic or explicit split flag. otherwise use routing ledger join at query-time for preview (slower but cheaper).

liz: UX experiment: show preview rollout for 25% of users in the route list and measure whether on-call uses inspector to reduce MTTR. capture click-throughs and subsequent model overrides.

maria: sounds good. next steps: sam drafts API spec for saved_views compatibility endpoints + pin toggle, joel drafts infra plan for conditional model-dim indexing, liz and i will make a mock for the inspector and AB plan. ana please write brief copy for the compatibility warning text.

ana: on it. suggestion for text: "This view references metrics or dimensions that may have changed since it was saved. Some numbers might be incomplete. Click to refresh compatibility or open a migration helper."

maria: perfect. thanks team. logging action items: INF-4501 (events), SAV-VIEW-API (spec by sam), TELE-INDEX-PR (joel estimate), UX-AB (liz mock). will drop a short RFC into #product-docs and tag eng infra. :rocket:
